title: Congratulations
simplified_paragraphs: A：你太了不起了。又得了汉语比赛的冠军。
B：哪里哪里,你过奖了。其实我只是运气比较好罢了。
A：你太谦虚了。明明是实力强。我们周末一起吃饭，好好庆祝一下吧。
B：没问题。到时候你们别客气，随便吃。我还想向你们介绍一下我的女朋友。
A：女朋友？你有女朋友了？天啊，怪不得你那么开心，原来是双喜临门啊！
traditional_paragraphs: A：你太了不起了。又得了漢語比賽的冠軍。
B：哪裏哪裏,你過獎了。其實我只是運氣比較好罷了。
A：你太謙虛了。明明是實力強。我們週末一起吃飯，好好慶祝一下吧。
B：沒問題。到時候你們別客氣，隨便吃。我還想向你們介紹一下我的女朋友。
A：女朋友？你有女朋友了？天啊，怪不得你那麼開心，原來是雙喜臨門啊！
pinyin_paragraphs: A： nǐ tài liǎo bu qǐ le。 yòu dé le Hàn yǔ bǐ sài de guàn jūn。
B： nǎ lǐ nǎ lǐ , nǐ guò jiǎng le。 qí shí wǒ zhǐ shì yùn qi bǐ jiào hǎo bà le。
A： nǐ tài qiān xū le。 míng míng shì shí lì qiáng。 wǒ men zhōu mò yī qǐ chī fàn， hǎo hǎo qìng zhù yī xià ba。
B： méi wèn tí。 dào shí hòu nǐ men bié kè qi， suí biàn chī。 wǒ hái xiǎng xiàng nǐ men jiè shào yī xià wǒ de nǚ péng you。
A： nǚ péng you？ nǐ yǒu nǚ péng you le？ tiān ā， guài bu de nǐ nà me kāi xīn， yuán lái shì shuāng xǐ lín mén a！
english_paragraphs: A: You’re amazing! You won the Chinese language competition again.
B: Oh, not at all. You’re too kind. I was just lucky, really.
A: You’re too modest. You won because you’re good at it. Let’s go out for a meal this weekend to celebrate!
B: Sounds good. Order whatever you like—it’s my treat. I’d also like to introduce you all to my girlfriend.
A: Girlfriend? You have a girlfriend? Wow, no wonder you’re so happy. You have two things to celebrate!
english_full:
A: You’re amazing! You won the Chinese language competition again.

B: Oh, not at all. You’re too kind. I was just lucky, really.

A: You’re too modest. You won because you’re good at it. Let’s go out for a meal this weekend to celebrate!

B: Sounds good. Order whatever you like—it’s my treat. I’d also like to introduce you all to my girlfriend.

A: Girlfriend? You have a girlfriend? Wow, no wonder you’re so happy. You have two things to celebrate!
